name: igm-launcher-workspace
description: iGM Launcher monorepo (Electrobun + Bun + Rust + Next.js static export)

scripts.build:app: bun run build:ui && bun run sync:ui && bun run --cwd apps/shell build
scripts.sync:installer: bun run --cwd apps/installer sync:ui && bun run --cwd apps/installer sync:payload
scripts.build:installer: bun run build:ui && bun run sync:ui && bun run --cwd apps/shell build && bun run portable && bun run sync:installer && bun run --cwd apps/installer build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/launcher-ui typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/shell typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/installer typecheck
